lines.text: It’s a Nintendo Switch!\nIt’s connected to the TV.
How many Pokémon are there in the world?

There’s an email from [VAR TRNAME(0001)]!\c
“Hey, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!
So here’s what you need to know as a Trainer...\c
“Press the A Button, and you can talk to all
kinds of people. And if you tilt the control stick
more, you can run!\c
“Plus, if you open up the main menu by pressing
the X Button, you can save your progress, too.\c
“Boy, I can’t wait to get started. Can you?
	– [VAR TRNAME(0001)]”
